title: Mailbox read and ACK transiently return 404 ("mailbox not found for this participant/session") while list_mailboxes shows the caller as a participant
outcome: A participant reading a mailbox the listing shows them in never gets a participant-not-found 404. If the participant check and the listing can briefly disagree (for example during a federation reconnect or relay projection refresh), the read either waits for the authoritative membership or returns a typed retryable error that names that cause.
acceptance: The cause of the disagreement between the read path's participant check and termal_list_mailboxes is identified with file and line, and stated in the item note (for example a stale relay or federation projection after a reconnect).

A behavioural test reproduces a read by a listed participant during the disagreeing window and shows the fixed behaviour: success, or a typed retryable error naming the cause, never 'mailbox not found for this participant'.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
